steps.name: Robin
steps.text: We've reached the destination, and the surrounding area is cleared. Signal's... clear. Now establishing communications link—

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: This is Robin. The communications station has been established. Now attempting connection. Lighthouse, Lighthouse. Please answer if you read.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: This is Lighthouse. The signal is normal. I can hear you loud and clear.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Now testing. 'All quiet on Rhodes Island.' Please read back.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: 'All quiet on Rhodes Island.'

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Confirmed communications have been established.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Robin, did you learn all your secret codes from movies?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: And battle records...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: They sound kind of... cool.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Haha, that's true. They are pretty cool.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Our mission today is to establish the communications network around the landship. Yours is the last node. Everybody else has already gone on back. Once you're back, we'll head back to the landship.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Right, it'll still be pretty early by the time we get back. How about we all have a meal at the cafeteria together?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: There's no need to be shy. It's just the operators on this mission today.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (Whispers) Hm? This picked up a new biosignal nearby.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (Whispers) It's very weak, but it should be around here.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Oh my—

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Weak howl)

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Robin, I'm gonna ask the others to order ahead for us. What do you want?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I have a question.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hm? What's wrong?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: If we find an injured cloudbeast, what should we do with it?

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Moves head in curiosity)

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Whoa, so cute! Can I touch it?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Lighthouse's given it a checkup. Its injuries aren't serious. It'll get better after getting treatment on the landship.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Are you going to adopt it?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I... I don't know.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Cloudbeasts are social animals, and this area isn't a suitable habitat for them.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's probably here because it wandered off from its pack while they were migrating. It won't be easy to find them.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: We'll be working in this area for a while, so we can try to look for its pack. This is also fate, though. Perhaps you should think about adopting it.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I don't know if I can...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Didn't you say you haven't been living a very healthy lifestyle?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Maybe keeping a pet will help you get rid of your bad habits.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Robin, this here's an automatic feeder and water fountain that Katie used to use. It's yours if you want it.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: And take this pet food, too.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Wait, I thought Katie was a beckbeast?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Relax. This pet food is for both beckbeasts and cloudbeasts. Humans can eat it too. From what I heard, it's pretty darn good, too.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Have you tried it before?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Nope, haha.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Th—Thanks.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: So, have you figured out what you want to call it yet?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: N—Not yet...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I'm just taking care of it for now. I haven't decided to adopt it yet...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: That won't do. You two will be spending lots of time together.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Are you going to keep calling it 'cloudbeast'?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I'm not really good at coming up with names...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: How about we all come up with a name for this little fella, and you pick one?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Good idea!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: What do you think, Robin?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I... Yeah...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Oh, right, Lighthouse. You said I gotta give the little fella medicine, right? I—I'll head back and do that right now!

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Confused cry)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Sorry, I shouldn't have used you as an excuse.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: They probably think I'm hard to get along with.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: What do you think?

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: I don't think so.

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: They're all really kind people. You can tell, can't you? You're just guessing that's how they see you.

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: They're worried whether you can really take care of yourself and me at the same time. That's why they got all those pet supplies and started coming up with ideas for my name.

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Howls impatiently)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Yeah, I know I'm just guessing.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: This is how I am. I have such a negative view of everyone, just like how I have a negative view of myself.

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Howls impatiently)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Are you hungry? It's time to eat.

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Eats happily)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Can people really eat this?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Mm... Kinda salty.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But it's actually pretty good.

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Looks up in puzzlement)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Okay, okay. I won't eat your food. Enjoy your meal.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I'll get myself a cup of coffee.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Do you want coffee?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I'm not sure you can have any, though...

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Cries with curiosity)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Okay... Just a little bit. It should be fine, right?
The feeble cub walks up to Robin's coffee cup and cautiously licks the coffee.

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Walks away in disgust)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: It doesn't taste good, right? Actually, I don't really like it myself.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But somehow, before I knew it, I was already used to the taste.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Come, let's watch a movie together.
Robin wraps herself in her blanket and lets out a sigh.
Then, she makes some room for the cloudbeast cub to crawl inside.

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Cries with joy)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Welcome to my castle.
Sometimes, she feels that Rhodes Island is too big of a place, so much so that it makes her feel uncomfortable. She prefers smaller spaces, where she feels enveloped.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Before I was sent to Mansfield... I'd tuck myself into bed like this every evening after work.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I'd find a movie, watch it, then look up some reviews afterwards. Sometimes, I even watched analysis videos online. After that, I'd go to bed.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: And it'd be all the better if it was raining outside.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I love it when it rains. That way, I won't feel pressured to go outside, and I get to stay in bed feeling extra at ease.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: It's great when it's raining, don't you agree?

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: But why do you look so lonely?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: In the past, to make a living and to pay for my dad's treatment... I had to live this kind of life.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I'm used to loneliness.

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: Are you going to stay lonely forever?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Is... Is that not okay?

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: This is Rhodes Island, not where you used to live. You have the choice to not be lonely.

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: As long as you wish for it.
A few days later...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: We've been searching all over whenever we're out on mission the last couple days. We haven't found a cloudbeast nest.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Yeah, Robin, I think you should brace yourself. You could be in this for the long run.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: If you can't bring yourself to say it, want me to tell her?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You see, he...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Hold on! Let me say it myself!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Well... It's about the cloudbeast's name. I thought about it, and I was in over my head. I didn't consider that you might actually be fond of the idea, so...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: No, actually, about that...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Do you guys have time after this?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Do you guys have time to come to my dorm room tomorrow to see the little fella and give it a name together?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Oh my! Of course!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Yeah, it ain't every day you invite us to do anything! I'm definitely coming!

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Yeah, I have a couple questions I wanted to ask you about keeping pets, too.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Haha, you can count on me!

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Catch, Hoppy!

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Howls excitedly)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Hey, Colin, I'm here for the little fella.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Hey, Robin!

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Thanks for playing with it while I was out on my mission.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: I oughta thank it instead! I love playing with it!

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Did you just call it Hoppy?

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Yep, I have a beckbeast back home called Poppy.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: And this one keeps hopping around. That's why I'm calling it Hoppy! Right, Hoppy?

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Confused cry)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Hoppy... That's a good name.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Robin, are you taking Hoppy back?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Okay, see you, Hoppy!

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Final check—Cleaning, done.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: The little fella's nest, done.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Simple decorations, done.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Invitation to Closure... sent.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Now I just gotta wait till everyone's here.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Okay, little fella. We gotta be at the top of our game today. Don't make the others worry about us, okay?
Robin holds the little fella in her arms and changes its bandages as she tells it what to do later and how she wants it to work with her.
Of course, she knows it can't actually understand her. Nonetheless, what they are about to do has her very excited.
Perhaps because she has gotten too absorbed in talking to the cloudbeast, by accident, she brushes the little fella's wounds.

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Shrieks angrily)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Ow, that hurt.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Sorry, little fella.
The little fella doesn't respond to Robin, only leaping to the side.
For some reason, Robin feels the excitement she had just a moment ago dampen immediately.
In its place, she feels a shred of anxiety.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Guess I'll head to Medical...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (Whispers) This doesn't mean anything.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (Whispers) I'll go get my wound treated quickly and go back for the rest of the prep.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Robin, are you hurt?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Huh... Domma?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Crap...

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Here you go.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: I had a look at the cloudbeast's medical report. It doesn't have any viruses.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: If you feel sick later, come pay me another visit.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Then I'll get...

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Robin, I don't think we've seen each other since we came to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: This's the first time.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Oh... R—Right.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: I looked for you a couple times, but you were never here.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: I heard you signed a different contract to get treatment for your father, and you've been workin' very hard. I was worried maybe you'd forgotten me.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I'd never, Domma. Not a kind soul like you...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I... I'm just worried that... maybe you'd end up hating me.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: How could I? You helped Anthony so much when we broke out of that prison.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Besides, if you weren't there in Mansfield to encourage me, I wouldn't've had the courage to settle down here.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Anthony hasn't ever told you?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Told me what? All he said was that the escape likely wouldn't've worked out without you.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (Grinds teeth and grumble) Anthony, you prick...
Robin was actually in her dorm room the few times that Domma tried to visit. She simply pretended that she was away.
And every time she visited the Medical Department, she always checked if Domma was away.
She has actually imagined a number of situations of herself running into Domma as well as thought about what to say to her when that happens.
However, for better or worse, she has never actually run into Domma until now.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Robin, what's wrong?
Robin remembers how ambitious she was.
Right, she ought to be braver!

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Domma, actually, back in the prison break, I betrayed Anthony. I almost cut his escape short. I almost killed him myself, even.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: He forgave me, but I haven't forgiven myself.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I've been really afraid to tell you this. You're such a kind soul, I thought maybe you would end up hating me if I told you.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Even so, I want to tell you. I'm not asking for your forgiveness. It's just that, only by telling you can I put my mind at ease... a little.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: I could never hate you.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: You had your reasons, didn't you? And we all got out and made it to Rhodes Island together. That alone's worth celebratin', no?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I invited a bunch of coworkers to come see the little fella today.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Do you want to come?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Robin. Robin?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Uh... yeah.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: It's nothing. Just that Anthony and I had some differences of opinion during our escape.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: I see, but we all got out and made it to Rhodes Island together. That alone's worth celebratin', no?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: When Anthony's back, let's all have a chat together.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: You're so useless, Robin.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: *sob* Completely and utterly useless.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I know Domma will forgive me... That's how kind she is.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: She's so kind, she didn't even begin to suspect I've been avoiding her.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But that's exactly why I can't bring myself to tell her.
The anxiety in her is growing more intense.
Subconsciously, she walks toward the cloudbeast's nest in hopes of getting some sense of comfort from the baby.
Yet the cloudbeast is nowhere to be found.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Hey, little fella?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Little fella?
Over the last few days, she has gotten used to having a small little thing pop out whenever she calls out, but that isn't happening right now.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Did I forget to lock the door when I went to Medical...?
Robin immediately checks her automatic door, and finds a few strands of its hair at the door.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Robin, why are you running? What's wrong?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Colin... Did the little fella... no, did Hoppy come look for you?

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Hoppy? Nope. What's wrong?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I found its hair on my door, so...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: No, I mean... When I went to Medical, I didn't close the door...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Ahh... no, no...

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Robin, here. Have some water.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Thanks...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Phew... You see, Hoppy ran out of my room. I'm looking for it now.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Did you see it come this way?

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Okay... I'll keep looking.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? Wait up! Rhodes Island's a huge place! How long do you plan on looking?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Huh... Closure? How'd you...?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I got your invitation, and I don't have anything to do today anyway, so I figured I'd come to your dorm room first to talk about which movie to watch, and then I saw you dashing out of your room.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Sorry, I was in such a hurry, I didn't see you...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Nah, I'm not trying to get you to apologize. What I'm saying is, you just gotta ask me for this kinda stuff.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You haven't forgotten who I am, right?

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Who are you, lady?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Uh... Alright, listen up, boy. The lady standing in front of you is Kazdel's genius engineer and the creator of Rhodes Island—Closure!

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But... I can't ask you to do this for me.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Come on, Robin. We put on four movie clubs together, plus we watched a dozen shit flicks together. And here I thought we're more than friends already—we're shit flick buddies.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Am I the only one who thinks that?

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: What kind of relationship is that?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Like, we watch shitty movies together. If you ever find some who's willing to watch shitty movies with you, that's a true friend, and you'd better treasure that friendship, kid.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Oh, okay...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Of course I see you as a good friend. It's just... I don't ask others for help often, so I didn't think...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Alright, then remember to come to me next time. If you don't, that means you don't think of me as a friend.
As she speaks, Closure uses her terminal and checks about a dozen surveillance cameras' footage. Finally, she finds the little fella's whereabouts.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hm... Looks like it ran off to the bridge.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: The bridge...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Maybe it wanted some fresh air since it's been inside for so long.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Or maybe it misses its family.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Well, whatever you think, that ain't a safe place for a small animal. You'd better head on over there now.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Yeah.
The training room isn't far away from the bridge. With Closure's guidance, Robin quickly made her way there.
There, the little fella is standing on a railing by the window, looking intently at the clouds faraway.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Do you miss home?

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Tilts head in puzzlement)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Life on Rhodes Island is good. You won't go hungry, and there'll probably be a lot of people who'll treat you well here.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But do you still want to go back to nature, where you belong?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Or do you want to stay here?
Robin tries to fantasize having a conversation with the little fella.
But she realizes she isn't able to.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I know. This is my decision to make.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But I haven't even figured out what to do, so how could I imagine how you'd answer?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Sooner or later, we need to decide.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Hoppy!

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Leaps around in excitement)
The cloudbeast ignores Robin, and immediately brightens up upon seeing the ball in the boy's hand.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Little boy, looks like you're really good friends with the cloudbeast, too.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Yep, it's my good buddy!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Considering how Robin is, forget about taking care of it, I'm more worried about her ending up dead.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Maybe you should take care of it instead.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Uh... I think that's up to Robin. Besides, I don't think it's important who takes care of it.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: I'll be happy as long as I can play with it every day.
When she sees the little fella playing with the boy, Robin suddenly realizes that, aside from herself, the cloudbeast cub has already found a new friend onboard Rhodes Island.
But it is only now that she truly understands what that means: The little fella has a lot of choices open to it.
The choice that she tried to force on it does not actually exist in the first place.
Just like the choice that she's forcing on herself does not actually exist.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I brought it here, so I have a responsibility to take care of it or help it find a home.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Besides, everyone says that keeping pets can help you improve your lifestyle...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What? Robin!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You came to me at three in the morning last night to talk about that crap that Nian directed!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I can tell at a glance that you're not that kinda girl!
Robin stares, blank, for a spell.
Has she actually gotten used to this lifestyle because of her life's circumstances, or is that just the person she is?
Or is it perhaps both?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But... that's not a good thing.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What's so bad about it? I've never had a proper work-life balance myself.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yesterday, I slept through Engineering's meeting. Eunectes tore me a new one, but look, I'm still here.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's nobody's business! Haha!
Hearing Closure's nonchalant response, Robin finally understands just what the anxiety she feels is actually about.
She feels remorse for what happened during their escape from prison, and she wants to one day tell Domma the truth.
She feels bad for not asking Closure for help, and she wishes to one day become someone who can ask her friends for help.
She is thankful for her coworkers' kindness, and she looks forward to the day she can return the favor.

She wants, she wishes, and she looks forward. That is why she is unwilling to admit that who she is right now cannot achieve any of this. She can't make herself like that just because of a single idea.
She simply can't tell Domma, because she cannot cross that hurdle in her mind.
She simply doesn't think to ask her friends when she needs help, because she has little to no friends.
She simply doesn't know how to respond to the kindness of others, because she has never actually accepted their kindness.
These chaotic ideas made her try her hardest to deny her past lifestyle, to the point that she tried to force all this on a little cloudbeast.
But the truth is it might be exactly as Closure says—

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: You're right. It's nobody's business.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That's my girl. If you had the time to worry about this stuff, you really should be figuring out what we should watch next.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Robin, catch!

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: You should play with Hoppy too!

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Sorry, little fella. Let's play.

steps.name: Cloudbeast
steps.text: (Howls happily)
